title: Spectral Log + export/integration with DATA
description: log.data always reads is_current=true interpretations fresh on each call — editing an interpretation is reflected automatically with no separate cache-invalidation step. export.to_dataset builds one Polars DataFrame (samples join interpretations join pivoted indices, by sample_id) and calls the EXISTING analysis/data/storage.py::save_dataset() directly — this creates a brand-new DATA-module dataset, not a live/bidirectional join into an existing one. Image (PNG/SVG) export is client-side only via Plotly's toImage — no backend round-trip.

response.dataset_id: string (new DATA-module dataset id, readable via the existing data.rows/data.list)
